messages:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in auth failures and token reuse detected for api-prod (svc: inference). 3 distinct source IPs showing repeated 401/403 with same token fragments. SIEM flagged possible token leakage in logs. Tripwire ID: TW-8492. <https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-2319|INC-2319>

Ash Patel: seeing this too — paging @sec and @oncall. any initial mitigation steps?

Mike Chen: taking lead. oncall, please ACK.

Oncall Pager: ACKed. I'm here.

Mike Chen: quick summary: 1) unusual token reuse from 54.83.12.0/24, 34.210.0.0/16, and 3.21.9.0/24 2) SIEM found a few log files in staging S3 containing truncated tokens (no clear PII) 3) ~37 customers reported 401s in last 20m.

Sara Gomez: tagging sec ops. we should assume tokens are compromised until proven otherwise. plan: rotate affected service API keys, revoke active sessions, block offending IP ranges at the WAF, and rotate any exposed CI keys.

Devon K.: can you confirm which keys show up in the leaked logs? I can start a rotation window.

Mike Chen: logs show partial bearers for svc-inference-prod and svc-telemetry-ingest. Full keys not in logs but enough to correlate reuse. recommend immediate rotation of both service keys and invalidate user sessions for impacted models.

Ash Patel: runbook step 1: revoke sessions for user-facing tokens from last 24h, step 2: rotate service keys, step 3: block IPs, step 4: notify customers and legal if needed. I'll open the incident page.

SRE-Bot: Created incident page: <https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-2319|INC-2319> — tracker and timeline attached.

Mike Chen: executing perimeter block now. @netops please mirror to edge ACLs.

Mike Chen: firewall commands:```bash
# block offending CIDRs temporarily
aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-xxxx --cidr 54.83.12.0/24 --rule-action deny --rule-number 200 --egress false
aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-xxxx --cidr 34.210.0.0/16 --rule-action deny --rule-number 201 --egress false
```

Mike Chen: WAF rule staged and active. seeing drop in traffic from those IPs.

Sara Gomez: I'll rotate keys for services. Using internal tool: redwoodctl. plan: rotate, push new key to k8s secret, trigger rolling restart for pods that pick up keys.

Sara Gomez: rotation commands (internal):```bash
# rotate service key
redwoodctl keys rotate --service svc-inference-prod --env prod --reason "suspected leak TW-8492"
# update k8s secret
kubectl -n inference patch secret svc-inference-keys -p '{"data":{"API_KEY":"<new-base64>"}}'
# rollout
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-workers
```

Devon K.: will need to invalidate KV caches / prefix caches so old tokens can't be reused from memcached. Mike, can you flush relevant caches?

Mike Chen: flushing prefix caches now, command:```bash
redis-cli -h redis-main-01 FLUSHDB
# targeted: redis-cli -h redis-main-01 EVAL "-- lua script to evict token prefixes" 0 <script>
```

Ash Patel: Customer impact note: we are seeing increased 401s and a few transient failures; models continue serving for most traffic. No alerts from DLP that PII was found in leaked S3 artifacts. Legal informed and standby.

Sara Gomez: rotating telemetry key next. scheduling a short maintenance window for svc-telemetry-ingest — will update INC-2319 with ETA.

Oncall Pager: handing off to Sara for keys rotation and customer comms at 18:40 UTC. I need to jump to another page. Summary: perimeter blocked, sessions revoked in flight, caches flushed, keys rotation in progress.

Mike Chen: noted. handoff timeline and state:```
- perimeter block applied to 3 CIDRs
- sessions: token invalidation kicked off (API auth layer revocation ID: rev-5587)
- caches: targeted flush complete
- svc-inference-prod key: new key created, secret patched in k8s, rollout started (30% pods restarted)
- telemetry key: rotation pending (Sara)
```

Sara Gomez: ACK handoff. I'll finish rotation and run smoke tests against small canary customers. If all green, we'll do a phased rollback of the WAF blocks (maintain blocks until keys fully rotated).

Devon K.: can someone pull a customer impact list? want a list to DM engineering managers and CS.

Ash Patel: @cs-team please prepare template for affected customers (401s) — short technical note + remediation steps. hold public comms until we confirm scope.

Mike Chen: logs snippet showing token fragments (sanitized):```text
2026-04-15T18:12:03Z GET /v1/generate 401 "Authorization: Bearer ********abcd1234"
2026-04-15T18:12:07Z POST /v1/embeddings 401 "Authorization: Bearer ********abcd1234"
```

Sara Gomez: post-rotation checklist: 1) confirm all pods running new secret 2) confirm no auth failures for canaries 3) verify no further token reuse in SIEM 4) update INC-2319 timeline and exec summary.

Oncall Pager: leaving note in the incident channel: handing off to Sara. please ping me if escalation needed. :white_check_mark:

Mike Chen: adding temporary mitigation tag and scheduling follow-up postmortem. 

Ash Patel: thanks all. Important: until we finalize key rotation, do not publish root cause details externally. Keep channel tight.

Sara Gomez: taking over. will update here and on INC-2319. starting rotation now — ETA 30m. :lock:
